messages:
claire: Quick postmortem follow-up 1 KV eviction pattern. Need clear owners for remediation + tests: regression cases, prompt vectors, load profiles, chaos drill.

tomo: I can own the regression cases + CI wiring. Plan: add 40 focused cases that reproduce hot-key tail behavior. PR by 2025-06-02.

raj: I'll take load profile and chaos drill. Proposal: two load patterns (steady 180rps 30m, short spike 2m 100->800rps) + replica isolate 30s. Will draft k6 + safe-chaos runbook.

claire: Great. @yara can you add canary gating in CI to fail deploys on p99/p999 regressions and kv-miss delta >7%? Also nightly runs for early detection.

yara: Yep. I'll add a canary job that runs the reg-suite and promptset evals on every deploy, plus nightly full run. Gate rules: p99 < 140ms, p999 < 320ms, kv-miss delta <7%.

tomo: Promptset will be 60 vectors: 40 sanitized session samples + 20 synthetic high-skew keys. Will include baseline metrics and where to store them.

raj: Chaos sketch (safe tooling):
```
run_load(profile="spike_short", rps=[100,800], duration=120)
wait(20)
isolate_replica("replica-2", 30s)
observe(["kv_hit_rate","p99_latency","errors"])
```
Will add abort conditions and dry-run flag.

claire: Please add alerts: page oncall if canary fails, create incident if nightly fails 3x. Also add rollback playbook link in PRs.

oncall-bot: Created SRE-6120: "KV-tail test & gating" assigned to tomo,raj due 2025-06-07.

tomo: I'll open the PRs today and tag reviewers. raj: will post the chaos checklist to #runbooks. Claire: I'll prepare a one-paragraph exec note.

claire: Thanks team 1 keep updates short in SRE-6120. :thumbsup:
